name: Robotphoenix Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Robotphoenix Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial robots and automation solutions in China and internationally. It offers products, such as parallel robots (Bat series), Scara robots (Python series), six-axis robots (Mantis series), AGV robots (Camel series), wafer handling robots (Lobster series), and intelligent controllers (Gorilla series); and services, including the development of control and vision systems, and the provision of integrated intelligent manufacturing solutions.
